title: os-dev.md: a project-thread session's harness writes an HTML-comment attribution line as PR body line 1, against 〈干净收尾〉's ban on HTML comments — name the exemption
body:
## Source

This was out-of-scope finding 2 of PR #25214 (card #25185). Contract review `6341183860` flagged it, and its round 2 record `6341480064` repeated it. The review sent it to the skills lane, as a card the seat files at ACCEPT.

## Finding

The session harness of a Claude Code project thread tells it to begin every PR body with an attribution block. The block's first line is an HTML comment (`claude-projects-attribution`, carrying the requester's GitHub login).

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` forbids HTML comments in GitHub text, at lines 18 and 322–323 (〈干净收尾〉). Its reason is that the sanitizer eats short angle-bracket fragments.

So every card thread breaks one of the two rules. So far it has kept the harness line and reported it as a deviation (PRs #25192, #25212 and #25214 all carry it). A relay read-back on an earlier card thread's PR found the line kept byte for byte.

## Ask

Add a one-line exemption to `os-dev.md`, shaped like the existing one for trailers the harness writes itself (line 286: report it, do not copy or rewrite it):

- the harness-required attribution line on PR body line 1 stays exactly as the harness gives it, and the dev reports it;
- the ban still covers every HTML comment the dev writes itself.

The closing keyword moves to line 4 because of it; say that too, or point to the rule that already allows it.

## Acceptance

- `os-dev.md` names the exemption in one line; nothing else in the ban is loosened.
- Line growth is paid by compression under `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, with no ceiling moved.
- The `.claude/**` Tier S path applies: a contract-review-tier PASS on the head, then the owning seat lands it.
